Elon saw every trap Zanny set in that Economist interview and refused to step in any of them.

She kept trying the classic bait-and-switch: take completely normal positions (secure borders, safe cities, fiscal sense) and relabel them “far-right” so she could force him into a defensive corner.

He didn’t flinch.
Didn’t soften.
Didn’t play along.
He just said it straight:
“I support the normal people. What you call the far right, falsely.”
Then he turned it around and pointed out that hundreds of millions of people actually agree with him while legacy media is the one bleeding trust.
No apologies. No walking anything back. Just pure clarity and zero tolerance for the narrative games.
That’s how you read the play and refuse to give an inch.

GROK 4.5 TAKES #1 ON LONG-HORIZON TERMINALBENCH
Grok 4.5 just ranked #1 on the Long-Horizon TerminalBench — a benchmark designed to test complex, long-running AI agent tasks.
This type of evaluation focuses on sustained reasoning, multi-step problem solving, and the ability to handle extended workflows rather than short, isolated questions.
xAI continues to show strength in practical agentic performance, not just traditional benchmarks.
Another strong result for Grok 4.5.

NEWS: Neuralink is demonstrating mind-controlled powered wheelchair technology. ♿🧠

• Clinical trial participants are exploring how to control a powered wheelchair using only their thoughts.
• The technology uses Neuralink's brain-computer interface to translate neural signals into movement commands.
• The research aims to expand independence and mobility for people with severe physical disabilities.

Another step forward in real-world brain-computer interface applications.
